summary: Full QA run for CR-124 covering V1-V20. 19 of 20 pass. V11 is a partial fail: the import preview handles country codes correctly but does not return country_code in the preview rows. Backend suite test_cr124_qa_full.py: 27/28 tests pass, and the only failure is V11. Regression: CR-085 and CR-100 suites pass 30/30 (they need the env vars CRM_TEST_OWNER_EMAIL and CRM_TEST_OWNER_PASSWORD). Older CR-124 suites pass. One unrelated test is out of date: test_phone_normalize.py::test_phone_match_key. Frontend V14 and V15 pass.

verification_matrix.V2: PASS - UK Guest stored as phone 7911123456, cc +44
verification_matrix.V3: PASS - search 7911123456 returns the UK Guest
verification_matrix.V4: PASS - unit check gives ('7911123456','+44','fixed'). The API call with raw '+447911123456' and no cc finds the existing +44 customer and returns 'already exists'
verification_matrix.V6: PASS - 200, saved and re-read with cc +1
verification_matrix.V7: PASS - search 17726 returns Fir Hills with cc +1
verification_matrix.V8: PASS - skip-otp returns 200 'Login successful', data.token present, customer_id = UK Guest id, is_new_customer false
verification_matrix.V9: PASS - UAE 501234567/+971 already exists and is stored correctly
verification_matrix.V10: PASS - feedback returns 200 'Feedback submitted' with linked=true (matched to the UK Guest)
verification_matrix.V11: PARTIAL FAIL - the row gets status 'new' and the cc is applied (7911123456,+44 gives 'update'; 12345678,+65 gives 'new'). But ImportPreviewRow has no country_code field, so the preview response and UI cannot show +44
verification_matrix.V13: PASS (code inspection) - whatsapp.py:836 reads customer.country_code, strips '+', and sends it as a separate country_code field. Edge risk listed in code review
verification_matrix.V14: PASS - QR registration dropdown shows 8 options with flags, default +91
verification_matrix.V18: PASS - phone_match +91 gives $in ['+91',None,'']; foreign cc matches exactly
verification_matrix.V20: PASS - export CSV has exactly one 'Country Code' column and the Fir Hills row shows +1. Re-importing a file with the 'Country Code' header is now classified as 'update', so the earlier round-trip bug is fixed

minor.issue: ImportPreviewRow (models/schemas.py:1292) and the builder in routers/customers.py around line 1562 leave out country_code, so V11 'preview shows country_code=+44' cannot be met. Classification itself is cc-aware and correct.

minor.endpoint: core/phone.py normalize_phone (raw E.164 with an unknown prefix)
minor.issue: The greedy regex fallback splits wrongly: '+27821234567' becomes cc='+2782', phone='1234567', status 'fixed'. It is stored with a junk cc instead of being rejected or kept as +27.

minor.endpoint: core/phone.py normalize_phone (explicit cc conflicts with raw prefix)
minor.issue: ('+919876543210', cc='+44') gives phone='919876543210', cc='+44'. ('+447911123456', cc='+91') silently switches to +44. The raw prefix and the explicit cc are not reconciled.

customer.get('country_code', '+91').replace(...) raises AttributeError when country_code is stored as None (the legacy null cc that CR-100 explicitly tolerates). Line 913 already uses the safe form (... or '+91').

action_items: Add country_code to ImportPreviewRow and pass r.get('country_code') in preview_import, and show it in the import preview table (V11)
core/phone.py: for '+' prefixes not in _KNOWN_CC, mark the number invalid or extend _KNOWN_CC instead of the greedy 1-4 digit regex split
(Optional) Update the out-of-date tests/test_phone_normalize.py::test_phone_match_key to expect CR-100's $in form
critical_code_review_comments: routers/customers.py is far over 700 lines (import/export code is around line 1400-1650) and should be split into modules
Regression suites test_cr085a/test_cr100 use os.environ['CRM_TEST_OWNER_PASSWORD'] and crash at collection (KeyError) unless it is exported
seed_data_creation: No new customers created (V1/V2/V4/V9/V19 all returned 'already exists'). Side effects: Fir Hills PUT to +91 was rejected, then PUT +1 again with no change. V8 skip-otp logged in the existing UK Guest. V10 created 1 feedback record (message 'TEST_cr124 qa', id cabc3776-5750-4074-af5a-227a727ad507). Import was preview only.
